topic: Setting up a home espresso station
headline: Your First Perfect Shot
summary: A simple, repeatable process for pulling a consistent espresso shot at home, from grinding to tamping to extraction.
steps: Grind 18g of fresh beans to a fine, even consistency
Distribute the grounds evenly in the portafilter basket
Tamp firmly and level with about 30 lbs of pressure
Lock the portafilter in and start the shot immediately
Aim for a 25-30 second extraction yielding 36g of espresso
